messages:
sophie.sales: Hey team — prospective enterprise POC asking for SIEM/audit evidence. They want admin activity logs, retention policy, delivery options (S3/Splunk), and schema samples. Need to reply with what we can share publicly vs. what needs NDA.

priya.security: We can share high-level control descriptions now. For sample events and S3 bucket configs we need an NDA or redact customer-identifying fields. We can provide synthetic logs that mirror schema.

alex.eng: For POC, we can enable admin-activity logging to object store and stream to Splunk via our connector. Retention defaults: 90d on hosted; Dedicated can be configured 1y+. Logs are encrypted at rest with KMS. I'll paste sample event.

alex.eng: ```json
{"event_type":"admin.login","user":"redwood-admin","timestamp":"2025-10-01T12:34:56Z","action":"grant_role","target":"project-123","ip":"203.0.113.5","request_id":"req_abc123"}
```

marco.ps: Customer asks about SIEM ingestion format — does the sample contain tokens/KV cache? we need to confirm no model inputs are logged by default.

priya.security: We do NOT log model inputs by default. System-level telemetry includes request metadata, model variant id, token counts, latency, and operator/admin actions. Inputs can be logged if customer opts in and we mark them as sensitive.

sophie.sales: @priya.security can you list the exact artifacts we can attach to CAIQ/SIG? Also need a short blurb for the vendor risk team.

priya.security: Artifacts: (1) Control narrative about logging & retention (2) Encrypted S3 bucket sample policy (3) Synthetic admin activity log JSON (4) Export config snippet for Splunk/Datadog. I'll prepare and attach.

alex.eng: Splunk HEC example config: ```bash
curl -X POST https://splunk.example/hec -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' -d '{"event":"..."}'
```

audIT-bot: Ticket created: VRR-5821 — \"Provide SIEM evidence for Acme POC\" — assignee: priya.security

marco.ps: POC ask: can we stream real-time admin events into customer's SIEM during trial? yes for Dedicated & Private; Hosted possible via syslog forwarding for approved enterprise customers.

sophie.sales: Pricing/POC note: customer wants 30-day trial with log forwarding. @alex.eng any cost/ops blockers?

alex.eng: No infra blockers, but for hosted we require config & security review; add one week to timeline. For Dedicated/Private it's straightforward once infra is provisioned.

priya.security: I'll draft the redacted artifacts by EOD and ping legal for an NDA template. If they sign NDA we can hand over full log samples including request/response IDs.

sophie.sales: Great — please add the attack-surface blurb: \"Admin actions are logged, immutable, encrypted, and retained per contract. Access is RBAC with MFA; audit trails are exportable to customer SIEM.\" I'll include in the proposal.

marco.ps: I'll prep the POC runbook: steps to enable export, test ingestion, validate events, and validate retention policy. ETA 2 business days.

sophie.sales: Thanks 🙏. We'll ask customer to sign the NDA and confirm the target SIEM (Splunk/Datadog/Sumo).
